sloka: भूमिर् हिरण्यम् रूपम् च निग्रहे कारणानि च ।तत्र कः ते वने लोभो मदीयेषु फलेषु वा ॥४-१७-३१॥
transliteration: bhūmir hiraṇyam rūpam ca nigrahe kāraṇāni ca ।tatra kaḥ te vane lobho madīyeṣu phaleṣu vā ॥4-17-31॥

translations.english: 'Submissiveness and modesty are the attributes of good rulers and should not be mixed up with benevolence and selfrestraint. Kings ought not to act (as they like) impulsively.
translations.hindi: हे बानर ! इस बिषय में सनु जी के शुभाचरण प्रतिपादक दो शलोक सुने जाते है । इनको धमंज्ञ पुरुषों ने भी माना हे और में भी मानता हू
